headline: Markets closed for weekend; FPI outflows, crude oil, and West Asia tension in focus ahead of Monday trading

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) pulled out ₹20,974 crore from Indian equities in September.
Crude oil price movements and the geopolitical situation in West Asia are expected to drive markets this week.
State Bank of India issued an advisory regarding a three-day nationwide bank strike.
India's exports to core BRICS markets surged 34% to $19.9 billion in FY27 so far.
whatHappening: Bengaluru-based A-One Steels India plans to raise ₹405 crore through an initial public offering.
Titan announced it is open to acquiring smaller brands and sees growth in the premium segment.
Oriental Insurance announced an investment of ₹500 crore to bolster its digital capabilities.
Mazagon Dock, RVNL, and Nestle India are set to be among the key stocks in focus on Monday.
summary:
Indian equities remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, 21 September.
Market participants are closely tracking ₹20,974 crore in September FPI outflows along with crude oil trends.
Major individual stocks in focus ahead of the next trading session include Titan, SBI, Mazagon Dock, RVNL, and Nestle India.
